name: avdiff_reversal_indneut
theme: Short-term reversal: price deviation from its own 5d mean (ts_av_diff), standardized, then industry-neutralized.

name: high_recency_momentum
theme: 52-week-high style momentum: fewer days since the 20d high (small ts_arg_max) = nearer the high -> keeps winning.

name: low_recency_recovery
theme: Recovery momentum: more days since the 20d low = the stock has left its trough behind and is trending up.

name: anchor_reversal_kth
error: simulation: Required attribute "k" must have a value. <linkToCommonErrorMessages>Learn more</linkToCommonErrorMessages>
theme: Reference-price reversal: price vs a robust anchor (5th element of the last 20 days) -> reverts toward the anchor.

name: info_staleness_fip
theme: Frog-in-the-pan: fewer days since price last changed = continuous information diffusion -> persistent drift.

name: retvol_cov_fade
theme: Return-volume covariance: high covariance = volume confirming moves = crowded/overextended -> fade it.

name: vwap_resid_reversal
theme: Idiosyncratic mispricing: residual of close regressed on vwap (rettype=0) = transient deviation -> mean-reverts.

name: concave_momentum
theme: Outlier-tamed momentum: 10d vwap change passed through a signed square-root so extreme moves do not dominate.

name: cond_reversal_tradewhen
theme: Conditional reversal: take the industry-relative reversal bet only on rising-volume days (trade_when); never force-exit.

name: quantile_extreme_fade
error: simulation: Invalid number of inputs : 2, should be exactly 1 input(s). <linkToCommonErrorMessages>Learn more</linkToCommonErrorMessages>
theme: Extremeness fade: high rolling-quantile of recent return = recent winner -> fade; hump caps turnover.

name: cov_fade_top1000
theme: Return-volume covariance fade on TOP1000 (cleaner names).

name: cov_fade_top1000_ind16
theme: Covariance fade, INDUSTRY-neutral, heavier decay to denoise.

name: cov_fade_sp_top1000
theme: Covariance fade sharpened by signed sqrt (tames tails), TOP1000.

name: combo_cov_vwaprev_top1000
theme: Diversified fade: volume-confirmed move fade + outlier-tamed vwap-move fade (two low-correlation reversal sources).

name: combo_cov_avdiff_top3000
theme: Same composite on the full TOP3000 universe.

name: cond_reversal_decay20_top1000
theme: Conditional industry-relative reversal, decay=20 to cut turnover.

name: combo2_w2cov_d12
theme: Weight the high-fitness covariance-fade term 2x, decay 12.

name: quad_d12
expression: -zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry) - zscore(signed_power(ts_delta(vwap, 10), 0.5)) - zscore(divide(close, open))

name: iv_skew60
theme: ATM put-call IV skew (60d), long high-skew.

name: skew_pv_news
expression: -group_zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60, industry) + -zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry)

name: skew2_pv_news
expression: 2 * (-group_zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60, industry)) + -zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry)

name: sn_pvhalf_d12
expression: -group_zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60, industry) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: sn_news15_pvhalf_d12
expression: -group_zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60, industry) + 1.5 * (group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry)) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: wins25_news_d16
theme: winsorize skew std2.5 + news, d16 t05.

name: rank_skew_news_d16
theme: group_rank skew + zscore news, d16 t05.

name: wins20_news_pvhalf_d16
expression: -winsorize(group_zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60, industry), std=2.0) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: mz_skew_news_d12
theme: market-zscore skew + news, d12 t05 (min change).

name: mz_skew_news_pvhalf_d16
expression: -zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: mz_skew_news_pvhalf_d20
expression: -zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: mzwins_news_pvhalf_d16
expression: -winsorize(zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60), std=2.5) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: mz_skew_news_pvhalf_d16_t04
expression: -zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60) + group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: sec_skew_news_pvhalf_d26

name: sec_skew_news15_pvhalf_d28
expression: -group_zscore(implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60, sector) + 1.5 * (group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry)) + 0.5 * (-zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry))

name: news2_pv_d6
theme: 2x news + PV, d6 (less smoothing, more SH).

name: news_pv_sent_d8
expression: group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry) + -zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry) + group_zscore(scl12_sentiment, industry)

name: news15_pv_sent_d8
expression: 1.5 * (group_zscore(ts_mean(news_pct_120min, 5), industry)) + -zscore(ts_covariance(returns, volume, 20)) - group_zscore(ts_av_diff(close, 5), industry) + group_zscore(scl12_sentiment, industry)
